description: This file defines test utilities for QUIC protocol, including a packet writer class and functions to generate initial packet sequences for testing QUIC connections.

classes.name: DelegatedPacketWriter
classes.description: A QuicPacketWriter implementation that delegates packet sending to a user-provided delegate.

methods.name: DelegatedPacketWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the writer with a delegate.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Indicates if the writer is currently blocked from writing.

methods.name: MessageTooBigErrorCode
methods.description: Returns error code if message is too big, nullopt otherwise.

methods.name: GetMaxPacketSize
methods.description: Returns maximum packet size for a given peer address.

methods.name: SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Indicates if release time is supported.

methods.name: IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates if batch mode is supported.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Provides buffer for next packet to write.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Sends a packet via the delegate.
